name: tsight-monorepo
description: See how a TypeScript codebase fits together, using only facts from the code and its git history

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tsight/core && npm run build -w @tsight/api && npm run build -w @tsight/web && npm run build -w tsight
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tsight/core && npm run test -w @tsight/web && npm run test -w tsight
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tsight/core && npm run typecheck -w @tsight/api && npm run typecheck -w @tsight/web && npm run typecheck -w tsight
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tsight/core && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @tsight/api" "npm run dev -w @tsight/web"
